overview.description: The Simplify Tax Aware Alternatives ETF (LQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in multi-strategy alternatives. The fund is actively managed, seeking capital appreciation through aglobalmulti-asset portfolio, including emergingmarkets.Investments includecommodities, currencies, real estate-related securities, derivatives, privately offered debt instruments, and ETFs that use strategies such asoptionwriting or macro investing. LQ was launched on May 4, 2026 and is issued by Simplify.

data.title: Simplify Launches Two Tax-Aware ETFs to Meet Advisor Demand for Simpler, More Efficient Portfolio Tools
data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Simplify launches two ETFs to help investors access diversified strategies while seeking to minimize the tax drag that can impact long-term results.
